The embedded 44-triangle convex boundary is included by squared radius 6; all 92 maximal squared-radius-12 cliques lie in positive open halfspaces. Thus radial projection is defined and is degree one on the boundary, proving the homology inclusion ranks and sphere-stage homotopy equivalences. Newly added squared-distance-four diagonals are homologous to original two-edge square paths, proving the first-degree inclusion surjection. Computation is exhaustive on 24 specified vertices and does not extrapolate.

The Euclidean metric naturally refines the known graph-distance-three threshold into three exact distances, and its first new shell already gives homotopy stabilization at a geometric 2-sphere. This is a motivated geometric topological classification, not a restated graph-metric or circle theorem, a tiny arbitrary slice, or just a homology table.
